topPRs.title: Ink mainnet migration — rollback tasks (eth/062-064)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Ink Mainnet Migration — ROLLBACK / contingency tasks

Reverse tasks to abort the Ink mainnet (chainId 57073) Gelato → OP Enterprise migration and return control to Gelato if the cutover cannot be completed. Companion to the forward tasks `eth/060` / `eth/061` (branch `af/ink-mainnet-migration`).

| Task | Reverses | Template | Signer |
|---|---|---|---|
| `062-ink-revert-system-config-owner` | `eth/055` (PR #1462), FOS → Gelato Safe | `TransferSystemConfigOwnership` | FoundationOperationsSafe |
| `063-ink-revert-batcher-unsafe-signer` | `eth/060` (steps 2 & 3) | `SetBatcherAndOrSigner` | FoundationOperationsSafe |
| `064-ink-revert-proposer-rotation` | `eth/061` (step 4) | `SetDisputeGameArgs` | L1PAO (nested FUS + SC) |

### Assumptions / direction
- Post-migration SystemConfig owner = **FoundationOperationsSafe** `0x9BA6e03D…006b3A` (per PR #1462, the actual forward transfer target; on Sepolia the same "OPE Safe" was the FoundationOperationsSafe `0x837DE4…Fd5E`). The reverts reverse from there back to the Gelato Safe `0xBeA2Bc…9Bbb`.
- 062 & 063 override `SystemConfig.owner()` (slot `0x33`) → FOS for standalone simulation, since live owner is still Gelato until the forward migration executes. Remove those overrides once the forward migration has landed.
- Challenger was never rotated during the migration (already OP gov `0x9BA6e03D…006b3A`), so 064 is proposer-only.

### Rollback order
1. `063` (restore Gelato batcher/unsafe signer) — while the OP side still owns SystemConfig.
2. `064` (restore Gelato proposer) — independent, L1PAO-signed.
3. `062` (hand SystemConfig ownership back to Gelato) — **last**.

> [!WARNING]
> **DRAFT — not signable.** All restore values (pre-migration Gelato batcher / unsafe signer / proposer) are placeholders marked `TODO` — they MUST be captured on-chain in the pre-migration role audit (§3.1) / execution log and pinned before signing. Safe nonces are `0` pending live reads. Re-simulate and fill VALIDATION.md hashes before use.

topPRs.title: Karst gas-limit reset — Soneium mainnet (060)
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
## Objective

Karst (U19) gas-limit reset for **Soneium** (chainId `1868`), mirroring the OP Mainnet task [055-gas-limit-op](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/tree/main/src/tasks/eth/055-gas-limit-op).

Karst leaves the effective L2 block gas limit ~55 MGas above the value stored in the SystemConfig (op-node/kona bug — see Notion "P/PS: Karst Gas Limit Bug"). Re-issuing `setGasLimit` re-emits the gas `ConfigUpdate`, which resets the effective gas limit back to the on-chain value.

The gas limit is **re-set to its current on-chain value (40,000,000)** — there is no net storage change; the mitigation is the re-emitted event.

## Ownership

Unlike OP Mainnet (rooted at the Foundation Upgrade Safe), Soneium's SystemConfig is owned by a **Soneium-operated 3-of-6 Safe** (`0x509182eC226b3B71D36A3255A80EF0b1A9D43033`). This task is rooted there and is **signed and executed by Soneium**, not by any OP-controlled safe.

## On-chain verification (mainnet, L1 chainId 1)

| Item | On-chain value |
|---|---|
| SystemConfigProxy | `0x7A8Ed66B319911A0F3E7288BDdAB30d9c0C875c3` (v3.14.2) |
| `SystemConfig.owner()` | `0x509182eC226b3B71D36A3255A80EF0b1A9D43033` |
| `SystemConfig.gasLimit()` | `40000000` (unchanged) |
| Owner safe | Safe v1.4.1, threshold **3-of-6** |
| Owner safe nonce | `12` (override) |

## Timing

Karst activates on Soneium at `karst_time = 1783526401` (**Wed 8 Jul 2026 16:00:01 UTC**). Execute after activation. Status is `[DRAFT]` — flip to `[READY TO SIGN]` at handoff.

> [!NOTE]
> Domain/message hashes in [VALIDATION.md](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/tree/main/src/tasks/eth/060-gas-limit-soneium/VALIDATION.md) are pinned to safe nonce **12**. If the safe transacts before signing, re-run `just simulate-stack eth 060-gas-limit-soneium` and update the hashes.

topPRs.title: Remove SystemConfig batch inbox getter reads
topPRs.author: mds1
topPRs.body:
Removes direct `SystemConfig.batchInbox()` reads from the OPCM upgrade templates and the V800 migration integration test.

These paths only need the value as a code-length exception for `SystemConfig` reinitialization, so they derive the standard batch inbox address from the L2 chain ID instead of calling the getter removed in ethereum-optimism/optimism#21638.

`AccountAccessParser` still decodes the raw storage slot, but now labels it as the legacy `SystemConfig` batch inbox slot. That keeps historical state-diff output readable without treating the slot as the source of truth.

Companion PRs:
- `optimism`: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21638
- `op-analytics`: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-analytics/pull/1798

topPRs.title: template: tolerate SystemConfig 4.0.0 batchInbox removal in OPCMUpgradeV800
topPRs.author: mds1
topPRs.body:
Prepares `OPCMUpgradeV800` for SystemConfig 4.0.0 (op-contracts v8.0.0), which removes the `batchInbox()` getter and clears the legacy batch inbox slot during reinitialization (https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21641).

Changes:

1. The template's dev-HACK block read `sysCfg.batchInbox()` to build the code-exception whitelist. That getter call now goes through a tolerant staticcall: against SystemConfig 3.14.x it behaves as before, against 4.0.0 the missing selector reverts with empty return data and resolves to `address(0)`, which is filtered out (the reinit writes zero to that slot, which needs no code exception). Any other failure — a revert with data — surfaces loudly via `require` instead of being mistaken for the post-removal case.
2. Removed `batchInbox()` from the `ISystemConfigV800` interface, and applied the same tolerant read to the `SuperRootMigrate` integration test, which called the removed member.

Worth noting for U20 validation: `AccountAccessParser` labels SystemConfig slots by their keccak values, so the two slot-clearing writes (`Batch inbox address` → `0x0`, start block → `0x0`) will show up correctly labeled in every chain's state diff. That is the expected diff, per https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21641.

`OPCMUpgradeV700` also reads `batchInbox()`, but only ever runs against pre-4.0.0 SystemConfigs, so it is untouched.

Related PRs: https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21641 (contracts), https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/specs/pull/922 (spec), the dev-docs edit rides along in the monorepo PR. Context: ethereum-optimism/optimism#21614.

topPRs.title: 055-gas-limit-op: mark task as executed
topPRs.author: claude
topPRs.body:
<!-- ccr-slack-attribution -->
_Requested via [Slack thread](https://oplabs-pbc.slack.com/archives/C03N11M0BBN/p1783528018486959?thread_ts=1783528018.486959&cid=C03N11M0BBN)_

## Summary

Marks task `055-gas-limit-op` as executed, fixing the failing `stacked_simulation_eth` CI job.

**What changed:** Task `055-gas-limit-op`'s status flips from "READY TO SIGN" to "EXECUTED" (linked to the on-chain tx). Before, the stacked ETH simulation kept re-simulating an already-executed task and failing; after, it's excluded from the active set and CI passes.

**Why:** The gas-limit change was executed on mainnet ([tx 0x8738995c...](https://etherscan.io/tx/0x8738995c1d3c654b0c919e39456a215db650dd75eae2feb13e463725c8362af7)), setting the SystemConfig gas limit to 40,000,000. Its recorded pre-state / validation no longer matches chain state, so `stacked_simulation_eth` fails while the task is still marked active.

**How:** `src/script/fetch-tasks.sh` includes a task in the simulation set unless its README `Status:` line contains `EXECUTED`, `CANCELLED`, or `APPROVED`. This one-line change adds `EXECUTED`.

Requested by Matt Solomon.

---

## For Task PRs

**Task path**: `src/tasks/eth/055-gas-limit-op`

This PR does not add or modify task logic — it only updates the README `Status:` line to reflect that the task has already been executed on-chain.

### Task Checklist

- [x] `README.md` is complete with accurate task description
- [x] Task status is set appropriately (now `EXECUTED`)

---

## Additional context

Single-line change to `src/tasks/eth/055-gas-limit-op/README.md`. No task logic or validation files are touched.
